old: Genesis 42:25 — *Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man’s money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.* The gold put back in the sacks unknown in Jubilees 42:6 is Genesis' restored money.
new: Genesis 42:25 — *Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man’s money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.* The gold put back in the sacks unknown in Jubilees 42:7 is Genesis' restored money.

old: Genesis 44:12 — *And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack* — the same search order and discovery that Jubilees 43:6 records.
new: Genesis 44:12 — *And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack* — the same search order and discovery that Jubilees 43:7 records.

old: Genesis 49:1 — *And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.* Jubilees 45:13 says Israel made known to his sons what would come upon them in the last days — this is that deathbed prophecy.
new: Genesis 49:1 — *And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.* Jubilees 45:14 says Israel made known to his sons what would come upon them in the last days — this is that deathbed prophecy.

old: Genesis 47:26 — *And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh’s.* Jubilees 45:11 calls it an ordinance for Egypt "until this day" — the very phrasing of Genesis.
new: Genesis 47:26 — *And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh’s.* Jubilees 45:12 calls it an ordinance for Egypt "until this day" — the very phrasing of Genesis.

old: Genesis 47:24 — *And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.* The fifth-for-the-king, four-parts-for-the-people split of Jubilees 45:11 is taken straight from Joseph's decree here.
new: Genesis 47:24 — *And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.* The fifth-for-the-king, four-parts-for-the-people split of Jubilees 45:12 is taken straight from Joseph's decree here.

old: Exodus 1:8 — *Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.* The stronger new king of Jubilees 46:6 is Exodus' king who knew not Joseph.
new: Exodus 1:8 — *Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.* The stronger new king of Jubilees 46:7 is Exodus' king who knew not Joseph.

old: Hebrews 11:27 — *By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.* The flight from Pharaoh's wrath in Jubilees 47:11 is the faith Hebrews credits to Moses' forsaking of Egypt.
new: Hebrews 11:27 — *By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.* The flight from Pharaoh's wrath in Jubilees 47:12 is the faith Hebrews credits to Moses' forsaking of Egypt.

old: Acts 7:25 — *For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that Elohim (God) by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.* The brother who turns on Moses in Jubilees 47:11 is Stephen's portrait of the deliverer rejected by his own.
new: Acts 7:25 — *For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that Elohim (God) by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.* The brother who turns on Moses in Jubilees 47:12 is Stephen's portrait of the deliverer rejected by his own.

old: Exodus 2:14 — *And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.* The rebuke and the fearful flight in Jubilees 47:11 quote Exodus 2:14 nearly verbatim.
new: Exodus 2:14 — *And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.* The rebuke and the fearful flight in Jubilees 47:12 quote Exodus 2:14 nearly verbatim.

old: Exodus 14:21 — *And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and Yahuah (LORD) caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.* This is the sea crossed 'as if it were dry land' in Jubilees 48:12.
new: Exodus 14:21 — *And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and Yahuah (LORD) caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.* This is the sea crossed 'as if it were dry land' in Jubilees 48:13.

old: Exodus 14:19 — *And the angel of Elohim (God), which went before the camp of Yashar'el (Israel), removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them.* This is the 'I stood between the Egyptians and Yashar'el' of Jubilees 48:12.
new: Exodus 14:19 — *And the angel of Elohim (God), which went before the camp of Yashar'el (Israel), removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them.* This is the 'I stood between the Egyptians and Yashar'el' of Jubilees 48:13.

old: Jubilees 10:1 — the persistence of the Watcher-spirits as unclean demons after the Flood. The lead-astray architecture the Pharisaic-Sadducean apparatus operates inside.
new: Jubilees 10:1 — *the unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah.* The leading astray that outlived the flood wears the robes John calls a generation of vipers (Matthew 3:7).

old: Jubilees 23:27 — *the days will begin to grow many and increase amongst those children of men, Till their days draw nigh to one thousand years.* The wisdom-stream's latter-day-renewal substance with no-Satan-no-evil-destroyer days-of-blessing-and-healing; the same Messianic-age-restoration the King's credentialing-signs inaugurate.
new: Jubilees 23:27 — *Till their days draw nigh to one thousand years.* The healing of the last days, tasted first in the blind seeing and the dead raised (Matthew 11:5).

old: Jubilees 1:23 — *I shall circumcise the foreskin of their heart ... I shall create in them a holy spirit, and I shall cleanse them so that they shall not turn away from Me.* The wisdom-stream's Tanakh-anchor parallel to Jeremiah 31:33 and Ezekiel 36:26-27; the new-heart-substance Matt 11:11 names operative in the kingdom-citizens.
new: Jubilees 1:23 — *I shall circumcise the foreskin of their heart and the foreskin of the heart of their seed.* What John announced from outside, the least in the kingdom carries inside, a heart circumcised and a holy spirit created (Matthew 11:11).

old: Jubilees 1:24 — *their souls will cleave to Me and to all My commandments, and they will fulfil My commandments.* The substance of the new-heart: souls-cleaving-to-Yahuah (God) and fulfilling-the-commandments; the inverse-of-the-false-inclusion-gospel — the covenant-children fulfil the commandments because the new-heart-substance has been wrought in them.
new: Jubilees 1:24 — *their souls will cleave to Me and to all My commandments, and they will fulfil My commandments.* The new heart keeps the commandments and the Father calls them children; this is what makes the least in the kingdom greater than the prophet (Matthew 11:11).

old: Jubilees 1:25 — *they will all be called children of the living Elohim (God).* The same phrase Hosea 1:10 names for the Lo-Ammi scattered-seed gathered-home; Paul cites at Romans 9:25-26; Matt 11:11 names the kingdom-citizens' transformation-of-status operative.
new: Jubilees 1:25 — *they will all be called children of the living Elohim (God).* Hosea's name for the house once called Not My People, known in heaven as His children; the least of them is greater than John (Matthew 11:11).

old: Jubilees 16:5 — *Yahuah (God) executed his judgments on Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Zeboim, and all the region of the Jordan, and He burned them with fire and brimstone, and destroyed them until this day.* The wisdom-stream's direct Sodom-destruction-narrative; Matt 11:23-24 invokes the same archetype.
new: Jubilees 16:5 — *He burned them with fire and brimstone, and destroyed them until this day.* The measuring rod of judgment; Capernaum, which saw the mighty works, will fare worse than Sodom (Matthew 11:23).

old: Jubilees 16:6 — *Elohim (God) will execute judgment on the places where they have done according to the uncleanness of the Sodomites, like to the judgment of Sodom.* Sodom as the template for future-judgments; Matt 11:23-24 walks the same template against the Galilean-cities.
new: Jubilees 16:6 — *Elohim (God) will execute judgment on the places where they have done according to the uncleanness of the Sodomites.* Sodom's judgment as a pattern still in use; Yahusha (Jesus) lays it over Capernaum (Matthew 11:23).

old: Jubilees 2:21 — *to eat and to drink, and to bless Him who hath created all things.* The wisdom-stream's Shabbat-as-day-of-eating-and-blessing; explicitly the opposite of the Pharisaic-fence-architecture's reading of restrictive-against-eating.
new: Jubilees 2:21 — *to eat and to drink, and to bless Him who has created all things.* The Sabbath as a day for eating and blessing the Creator; the Lord of the Sabbath defends his disciples' eating (Matthew 12:8).

old: Jubilees 50:12 — the late-Jubilees Shabbat-prohibition code documenting the Second-Temple stringency the Pharisaic-fence inherited and intensified; the King at Matt 12:12 restores the heart-Shabbat-substance.
new: Jubilees 50:12 — *whoever fasts or makes war on the Sabbaths.* Jubilees' list of what the Sabbath forbids; doing well was never on it (Matthew 12:12).

old: Jubilees 10:11 — *all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth part of them we left to be subject before Satan.* The wisdom-stream's partial-binding-with-a-remnant-operating architecture; the King at Matt 12:29 walks the inaugurated-completion.
new: Jubilees 10:11 — *a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the earth.* Nine parts bound and a tenth left loose; the strong man is bound before his house is spoiled (Matthew 12:29).

old: Jubilees 15:33 — *great wrath from Yahuah (the Lord) ... because they have forsaken His covenant and have turned aside from His word.* The wisdom-stream's deliberate-covenant-rejection architecture; the blasphemy-against-the-Ruach Yahusha (Jesus) names is the operative-form.
new: Jubilees 15:34 — *there will no more be pardon or forgiveness to them.* The deliberate forsaking of the covenant and the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) at Matthew 12:31 end in the same place, past forgiveness.

old: Jubilees 23:30 — *the Lord will heal His servants, And they shall rise up and see great peace.* The wisdom-stream's rise-up-and-see-great-peace architecture; the King's resurrection at Matt 12:40 is the inaugurated-credentialing.
new: Jubilees 23:30 — *Yahuah (God) will heal His servants, And they will rise up and see great peace.* The servants rise because the Master rose first, three days and three nights in the heart of the earth (Matthew 12:40).

old: Jubilees 1:23 — *I shall create in them a holy spirit, and I shall cleanse them so that they shall not turn away from Me.* The wisdom-stream's new-heart-and-holy-spirit-cleansing architecture; the empty-house parable's negative-correlate diagnoses what is missing.
new: Jubilees 1:23 — *I shall create in them a holy spirit, and I shall cleanse them.* What must fill the swept house, or the seven return (Matthew 12:45).

old: Jubilees 1:24 — *they will fulfil My commandments, and I shall be their Father and they will be My children.* The wisdom-stream's direct architecture of fulfilling-the-commandments yields the Father-and-children-relation; Matt 12:50 names the same substance at the kingdom-family register.
new: Jubilees 1:24 — *I shall be their Father and they will be My children.* The Father's children are the ones who cleave to His commandments; the same mark names the King's family (Matthew 12:50).

old: Jubilees 11:11 — *Prince Mastema sent ravens and birds to devour the seed which was sown in the land ... the ravens picked it from the surface of the ground.* THE strongest direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for Matt 13:4's fowls-came-and-devoured-them-up substance; Mastema-sending-the-birds is the wisdom-stream restatement the King at Matt 13:19 identifies as the wicked-one-catching-away.
new: Jubilees 11:11 — *the prince Mastêmâ sent ravens and birds to devour the seed which was sown in the land.* The birds that devour the seed were sent; the fowls by the way side are the wicked one (Matthew 13:4, 19).

old: Jubilees 5:1 — *the angels of Yahuah (the Lord) saw them ... and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare unto them sons and they were giants.* The wisdom-stream's second-witness to the watchers' incursion alongside 1 Enoch 6 — two-wisdom-stream witnesses establish the substance the King's parable names.
new: Jubilees 5:1 — *they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.* The first tares sown in the field while men slept (Matthew 13:25).

old: Jubilees 7:21 — *owing to the fornication wherein the Watchers ... they begat sons the Naphidim, and they were all unlike, and they devoured one another: and the Giants slew the Naphil.* The wisdom-stream names the multiple-corrupted-lineages from the watchers' fornication; the architecture of the pre-flood-corruption continues post-flood as the field-of-the-world architecture the wheat-and-tares parable names.
new: Jubilees 7:21 — *the Watchers against the law of their ordinances went a whoring after the daughters of men.* The seed that was never the Father's; the tares are the children of the wicked one (Matthew 13:38).

old: Jubilees 4:2 — *Qayin (Cain) slew Hevel (Abel) ... and his blood cried from the ground to heaven.* The wisdom-stream's direct restatement of the Bereshit (Genesis) 4 architecture; Qayin is the wisdom-stream-and-apostolic-letter-identified first-fruit of the children-of-the-wicked-one (corroborated by 1 Yochanan (John) 3:12).
new: Jubilees 4:2 — *Cain slew Abel because Elohim (God) accepted the sacrifice of Abel.* The first of the children of the wicked one, *who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother* (1 John 3:12; Matthew 13:38).

old: Jubilees 15:30 — *for Ishmael and his sons and his brothers and Esau, Yahuah (God) did not cause to approach Him, and he chose them not because they are the children of Abraham, because He knew them, but He chose Yashar'el (Israel) to be His people.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the seed-of-promise-specifically-to-Yashar'el (Israel)-NOT-to-other-seed-of-Avraham (Abraham) substance; the architecture the Canaanite-woman pericope at vv.22-28 operates within, with the King's-children-vs-dogs distinction at v.26 honoring the wisdom-stream's articulation.
new: Jubilees 15:30 — *he chose them not because they are the children of Abraham, because He knew them, but He chose Yashar’el (Israel).* Not every child of Abraham is the chosen seed; the woman on the coast of Canaan who knew the Son of David is one of the lost sheep he was sent to (Matthew 15:22).

old: Jubilees 15:31 — *for there are many nations and many peoples, and all are His, and over all has He placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from Him.* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the spiritual-jurisdictional architecture over the nations (the *bene Elohim* allocation per Devarim (Deuteronomy) 32:8-9's Septuagint and Dead Sea Scrolls reading); the King's-distinction at v.26 operates in the architecture.
new: Jubilees 15:31 — *over all has He placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from Him.* The nations under spirits, Yashar'el (Israel) gathered out to be ruled directly; the children's bread (Matthew 15:26).

old: Jubilees 15:32 — *but over Yashar'el (Israel) He did not appoint any angel or spirit, for He alone is their ruler.* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the Yashar'el (Israel)-under-Yahuah's-direct-rule architecture the King's-mission-to-the-lost-sheep at v.24 enacts under the Father's-direct-shepherding (Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34:11-16).
new: Jubilees 15:32 — *over Yashar’el (Israel) He did not appoint any angel or spirit, for He alone is their ruler.* The flock the Father shepherds Himself; the children's bread is theirs, and the woman on the coast of Canaan was one of the children (Matthew 15:26).

old: Jubilees 16:17 — *all the seed of his sons should be nations, and be reckoned with the nations; but from the sons of Isaac one should become a holy seed, and should not be reckoned among the nations. For he should become the portion of Yahuah (God) most High.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the holy-seed-from-the-sons-of-Yitschaq (Isaac)-NOT-reckoned-among-the-nations architecture. The Canaanite-woman is outside the seed-architecture the wisdom-stream had named with explicit-precision.
new: Jubilees 16:17 — *from the sons of Isaac one should become a holy seed, and should not be reckoned among the nations.* The holy seed not reckoned among the nations; the children's bread (Matthew 15:26).

old: Jubilees 50:1 — *after this law I made known to you the days of the Sabbaths in the desert of Sinai.* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the Sabbath-architecture-revealed-in-the-desert-of-Sinai substance — the architecture Jubilees structures the entire-Tanakh-chronology around.
new: Jubilees 50:1 — *I made known to you the days of the Sabbaths in the desert of Sinai.* The Sabbaths built on seven; the second feeding leaves seven baskets (Matthew 15:37).

old: Jubilees 50:2 — *I told you of the Sabbaths of the land on Mount Sinai, and I told you of the jubilee years in the sabbaths of years.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the jubilee-years-in-the-sabbaths-of-years architecture — the seven-times-seven-years-equals-forty-nine-then-the-fiftieth-year-jubilee substance of Vayikra (Leviticus) 25:8-10 the seven-baskets-of-the-second-feeding signal.
new: Jubilees 50:2 — *I told you of the jubilee years in the sabbaths of years.* The jubilee counted in sevens; seven baskets left over at the second feeding (Matthew 15:37).

old: Jubilees 50:4 — *I have ordained for you the year-weeks and the years and the jubilees: there are forty-nine jubilees from the days of Adam until this day.* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the forty-nine-jubilees-from-Adam chronological-architecture — the framework's-chronological-substance the seven-baskets-of-the-second-feeding signal at the gospel-fulfillment-pivot. The framework reads this in continuity with Luke 4:18-21's Natsareth (Nazareth)-synagogue-reading of Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 61:1-2's *acceptable year of Yahuah (the LORD)*.
new: Jubilees 50:4 — *there are forty-nine jubilees from the days of Adam until this day.* The world counted in sevens from Adam; seven baskets over when the jubilee has a face (Matthew 15:37).

old: Jubilees 3:4 — *Yahuah (God) said to us: "It is not good that the man should be alone: let us make a helpmeet for him."* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Bereshit (Genesis) 2:18 creation-ordinance substance the King appeals-behind-Mosheh to at Matt 19:4 — the Father's-will-from-the-beginning is the substance-of-reference behind the Deuteronomy 24:1 concession-to-hardness-of-heart.
new: Jubilees 3:4 — *It is not good that the man should be alone: let us make a helpmeet for him.* The beginning the King reads from before he reads Moses (Matthew 19:4).

old: Jubilees 3:6 — *He brought her to him, and he knew her, and said to her: "This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she will be called my wife; because she was taken from her husband."* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the one-flesh-from-the-beginning substance the King restates at Matt 19:5 — the woman taken-from-the-man-himself per Red Line #11's seed-and-marriage-covenant architecture.
new: Jubilees 3:6 — *This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she will be called my wife.* One flesh because she was taken from him; the *for this cause* of Matthew 19:5.

old: Jubilees 1:15 — *they will turn to Me from amongst the nations with all their heart and with all their soul and with all their strength, and I shall gather them from amongst all the nations.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the gathering-from-amongst-all-the-nations substance — the architecture the King's-Matt-19:28-statement presupposes-as-the-completed-gathering, in continuity with Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 37:21-22 + Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 11:11-12 + Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:31 per Red Line #11.
new: Jubilees 1:15 — *I shall gather them from amongst all the nations.* The gathering that puts twelve tribes under twelve thrones (Matthew 19:28).

old: Jubilees 31:15 — *they will be princes and judges, and chiefs of all the seed of the sons of Jacob; They will speak the word of Yahuah (God) in righteousness, And they will judge all His judgments in righteousness.* THE direct verbal-anchor for the princes-and-judges-of-all-the-seed-of-the-sons-of-Jacob substance — the architecture the King's *judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel)* at Matt 19:28 carries forward; the Greek *krinontes* is the same Tanakh-Shofetim (Judges) governance-substance.
new: Jubilees 31:15 — *they will be princes and judges, and chiefs of all the seed of the sons of Jacob.* Levi's blessing of judgeship over Jacob's seed; twelve thrones over the twelve tribes (Matthew 19:28).

old: Jubilees 5:2 — *lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way, alike men and cattle and beasts and birds.* The lawlessness-substance the days-of-Noach (Noah) walked into — the same Greek-anomia / torahlessness substance the King walks at Matt 24:12 (*because iniquity (anomia, torahlessness) shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold*); the substantial-modern-period walks the same substantial-substance the substantial-modern-institutional-Christianity walks the substantial-truncated-Reformation-grammar that-pits-grace-against-the-Torah the apostle-Sha'ul (Paul) never-walked.
new: Jubilees 5:2 — *lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way.* The days of Noah were days of lawlessness; so will the coming of the Son of Adam be (Matthew 24:37).

old: Jubilees 5:19 — *no man's person was accepted save that of Noach (Noah) alone; for his person was accepted in behalf of his sons.* The no-man's-person-accepted-save-Noach (Noah) substance — the substantial-pattern the *one shall be taken, and the other left* at Matt 24:40-41 walks-the-architecture-of; the Lukan-parallel at Luke 17:34-37 (*wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together*) confirms the *taken* substance walks-into-the-substantial-judgment, NOT the substantial-rescue.
new: Jubilees 5:19 — *no man’s person was accepted save that of Noah alone.* The one accepted was the one left; the flood took the rest (Matthew 24:38).

old: Jubilees 1:15 — *and after this they will turn to Me from amongst the nations with all their heart and with all their soul and with all their strength, and I shall gather them from amongst all the nations.* THE direct verbal-anchor for the Father-gathering-the-citizens-from-amongst-all-the-nations substance — the substantial-territorial-gathering the Great-Commission walks-out. The Shema (Deuteronomy 6:5) woven-into the gathering-architecture: the citizens return to the Father with-all-their-heart-and-with-all-their-soul-and-with-all-their-strength from-the-territories-of-their-scattering.
new: Jubilees 1:15 — *they will turn to Me from amongst the nations with all their heart and with all their soul.* The gathering from among all nations, carried out by sending to all nations (Matthew 28:19).

old: Jubilees 1:23 — *I shall circumcise the foreskin of their heart and the foreskin of the heart of their seed, and I shall create in them a holy spirit, and I shall cleanse them so that they shall not turn from following Me.* THE direct verbal-anchor for the circumcised-heart + holy-spirit-given substance — the new-covenant architecture of Jeremiah 31:31-34 + Ezekiel 36:26-27. The substantial-teaching-them-to-observe-all-things at Matt 28:20 + the baptizing-them at Matt 28:19b enact the operative-form of the substance the wisdom-stream had named the architecture for — the heart-Torah-substance directly-closing the Matt 5:17-19 bookend. NOT the inherited-Christian-antinomian-grace-replaces-Torah substance per Red Line #10. The 1 John 2:3-4 1234-of-Truth substance.
new: Jubilees 1:23 — *I shall cleanse them so that they shall not turn away from Me from that day to eternity.* The new heart that keeps what the disciples are sent to teach (Matthew 28:20).

old: Jubilees 1:25 — *and they will all be called children of the living Elohim (God), and every angel and every spirit will know, yea, they will know that these are My children, and that I am their Father in uprightness and righteousness, and that I love them.* THE direct verbal-anchor for the Hosea 1:10's *ye are the sons of the living Elohim (God)* substance the apostle-Sha'ul (Paul) cites at Romans 9:25-26. The substantial-Lo-Ammi-reversal substance the scattered-seed-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walks-out at the Father's-second-recovery. The substantial-substance is the SCOPE-of-the-proclamation: the citizens-scattered-among-the-territories-of-the-nations are the children-of-the-living-Elohim (God) whom the Father gathers per Red Line #11 + Red Line #7.
new: Jubilees 1:25 — *they will know that these are My children, and that I am their Father.* Hosea's sons of the living Elohim (God), sought where they were scattered (Matthew 28:19).

old: Jubilees 10:11 — *all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the earth.* The watchers-bound-with-a-tenth-permitted architecture; Luke 11:22's spoiled strong man is the partial-binding walking toward its completion — the King's casting-out (Luke 11:14) the inaugurated overcoming.
new: Jubilees 10:11 — *all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation.* The binding begun at Noah's prayer, finished by the stronger one who divides the spoils (Luke 11:22).

old: Jubilees 5:2 — *lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way.* The total-corruption that brought the flood; Luke 17:27's eating-drinking-marrying surface is obliviousness over the same corruption-judgment the flood answered.
new: Jubilees 5:2 — *every imagination of the thoughts of all men (was) thus evil continually.* What lay under the eating and drinking of Noah's days (Luke 17:27).

old: *the nation... shall I judge, and after that they will come forth... with much substance* (Jubilees 14:14) — the deliverance of 15:14 carried entire in the restored witness.
new: Jubilees 14:14 — *after that they will come forth thence with much substance.* The exodus promised to Abram in the same breath as the bondage (Genesis 15:14).

old: Psalm 139:16 — *Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.* The pre-written divisions of days in Jubilees 1:25-29 match the days written in Yahuah's book before any of them existed.
new: Jubilees 1:26 — *the first and the last, which shall come to pass in all the divisions of the days.* Written before it happens, as David's members were written in the book before there was one of them (Psalm 139:16).

old: Psalm 139:16 — *Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.* The judgement 'written on the heavenly tables' in Jubilees 5:13 is the same pre-written book David knew.
new: Jubilees 5:13 — *the judgment of all is ordained and written on the heavenly tables in righteousness.* The same pre-written book David saw in Psalm 139:16, opened to the page of judgment.

old: Psalm 139:16 — *Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.* The blessing recorded on the heavenly tables (Jubilees 31:32) belongs to the same pre-written book this Psalm names.
new: Jubilees 31:32 — *they record it as an eternal testimony to them on the heavenly tables how Isaac blessed them.* The blessing written in the same book where David's members were written (Psalm 139:16).

old: Psalm 139:16 — *Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.* The seven tablets that show Jacob "all... which would befall him and his sons throughout all the ages" (Jubilees 32:20) are this heavenly book where the days are written before they are.
new: Jubilees 32:21 — *an angel descended from heaven with seven tablets in his hands, and he gave them to Jacob.* Jacob read what would befall his sons through all the ages, already written, as David's days were written before they came (Psalm 139:16).

old: Deuteronomy 14:23 — *And thou shalt eat before Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) always.* The heavenly-tablet law to "eat before Yahuah... in the place where it is chosen that His name should dwell" (Jubilees 32:10) is this Deuteronomy command verbatim in substance.
new: Jubilees 32:10 — *in the place where it is chosen that His name should dwell, and to this law there is no limit.* The tithe law of Deuteronomy 14:23 was on the heavenly tables before Sinai, with no limit of days.

old: Psalm 139:16 — *Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.* The heavenly book that pre-writes what Jubilees 33:16 calls the law 'written' before it was revealed.
new: Jubilees 33:16 — *there had not been revealed the ordinance and judgment and law in its completeness for all.* Written before it was revealed, the way David's days were written before they came (Psalm 139:16).

old: Psalm 105:21 — *He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance.* The exaltation of Jubilees 40 (ruler over all Egypt) is Psalm 105:21 confessing Yahuah, not Pharaoh, as the one who made him lord.
new: Jubilees 40:7 — *made him ruler over all his house, and magnified him.* Pharaoh did the clothing and the speaking, but Psalm 105:21 says who made Joseph lord: *He made him lord of his house*, and the He is Yahuah (God).

old: Genesis 41:30 — *And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land.* The “seven years of famine, such a famine as has not been” of Jubilees 40:3 is Genesis 41:30 word for word in substance.
new: Jubilees 40:3 — *seven years of famine, such a famine as has not been in all the land.* The same reading Joseph gives Pharaoh in Genesis 41:30.

old: Genesis 15:14 — *And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.* The Abrahamic covenant that the 'bring you up again' of Jubilees 44:6 is fulfilling — the descent and the exodus were promised long before.
new: Jubilees 44:6 — *I shall go down with you, and I shall bring you up (again).* The oath of Genesis 15:14, in and judged and out, spoken to Jacob at the door of Egypt.

old: Jubilees 5:8 — *And He said "Your spirit will not always abide on man; for they also are flesh and their days shall be one hundred and twenty years."* The same hundred and twenty year decree against corrupted flesh stands in the live Jubilees apparatus beside Jasher 5:8.
new: Jubilees 5:8 — *Your spirit will not always abide on man; for they also are flesh.* The hundred and twenty years that Jasher 5:8 calls a space to turn before the flood.

old: Jubilees 5:22 — *And Noah made the ark in all respects as He commanded him, in the twenty-seventh jubilee of years, in the fifth week in the fifth year (on the new moon of the first month).* The live Jubilees apparatus dates the same obedient ark-building Jasher 5:33 narrates.
new: Jubilees 5:22 — *Noah made the ark in all respects as He commanded him.* The obedient building Jasher 5:33 records, here given its date.

old: Jubilees 8:10 — *And it came to pass in the beginning of the thirty-third jubilee that they divided the earth into three parts, for Shem and Ham and Japheth, according to the inheritance of each, in the first year in the first week, when one of us, who had been sent, was with them.* The live Jubilees apparatus tells the same three-way division of the earth among Noah's sons.
new: Jubilees 8:10 — *they divided the earth into three parts, for Shem and Ham and Japheth.* The three sons Jasher 7:1 names become the three portions of the earth.

old: Jubilees 8:8 — *And in the sixth year thereof, she bare him a son, and he called his name Peleg; for in the days when he was born the children of Noah began to divide the earth amongst themselves: for this reason he called his name Peleg.* The live Jubilees apparatus names the same Peleg born when the earth was divided.
new: Jubilees 8:8 — *for in the days when he was born the children of Noah began to divide the earth amongst themselves.* The same reason for the name that Jasher 7:19 gives.

old: Jubilees 10:19 — *For they departed from the land of Ararat eastward to Shinar; for in his days they built the city and the tower, saying, "Go to, let us ascend thereby into heaven."* The live Jubilees apparatus tells the same city and tower at Shinar that Jasher 7:18 narrates under Nimrod.
new: Jubilees 10:19 — *in his days they built the city and the tower, saying, “Go to, let us ascend thereby into heaven.”* The city Jasher 7:42 says Nimrod's counselors advised him to build.

old: Jubilees 9:3 — *And for Asshur came forth the second portion, all the land of Asshur and Nineveh and Shinar and to the border of India, and it ascends and skirts the river.* The Jubilees apparatus apportions Asshur the same Nineveh-and-Shinar territory that Jasher 10:32 says Asshur went forth to build.
new: Jubilees 9:3 — *for Asshur came forth the second portion, all the land of Asshur and Nineveh and Shinar.* The land Jasher 10:32 says Asshur went out and built four cities in.

old: Jubilees 9:1 — *And Ham divided amongst his sons, and the first portion came forth for Cush towards the east, and to the west of him for Mizraim, and to the west . of him for Put, and to the west of him and to the west thereof on the sea for Canaan.* The Jubilees apparatus apportions by lot the same four sons of Ham that Jasher 10:19 names.
new: Jubilees 9:1 — *Ham divided amongst his sons, and the first portion came forth for Cush towards the east.* The four sons of Ham that Jasher 10:19 names, receiving their lots.

old: Jubilees 9:8 — *And the first portion came forth for Gomer to the east from the north side to the river Tînâ; and in the north there came forth for Magog all the inner portions of the north until it reaches to the sea of Mê’at.* The Jubilees apparatus apportions by lot the same sons of Japheth — Gomer and Magog — that Jasher 10:7 lists.
new: Jubilees 9:8 — *the first portion came forth for Gomer to the east from the north side to the river Tînâ.* The sons of Japheth Jasher 10:7 lists, Gomer and Magog, given their borders.

old: Jubilees 10:25 — *For this reason the whole land of Shinar is called Babel, because Yahuah (God) did there confound all the language of the children of men, and from thence they were dispersed into their cities, each according to his language and his nation.* The Jubilees apparatus seals the same dispersal-into-cities that Jasher 10:2 opens this chapter with.
new: Jubilees 10:25 — *from thence they were dispersed into their cities, each according to his language and his nation.* The scattering from the tower that Jasher 10:2 opens with.

old: Jubilees 8:8 — *And in the sixth year thereof, she bare him a son, and he called his name Peleg; for in the days when he was born the children of Noah began to divide the earth amongst themselves: for this reason he called his name Peleg.* The Jubilees apparatus names Peleg by the identical dividing of the earth Jasher 10:1 stands at the head of.
new: Jubilees 8:8 — *in the days when he was born the children of Noah began to divide the earth amongst themselves.* The birth of the Peleg whose death Jasher 10:1 records.

old: Jubilees 12:28 — *And it came to pass in the seventh year of the sixth week that he spoke to his father, and informed him that he would leave Haran to go into the land of Canaan to see it and return to him...* — the Jubilees apparatus keeps the same Haran stop on the road to Canaan that opens Jasher 13:1.
new: Jubilees 12:28 — *he would leave Haran to go into the land of Canaan to see it and return to him.* Leaving the Haran stop that Jasher 13:1 says Terah settled into.

old: Jubilees 13:2 — *...And Yahuah (God) said to him: “To you and to your seed will I give this land.”* — the Jubilees apparatus carries the same land-grant to the seed at Abram's entry that Jasher 13:7 records.
new: Jubilees 13:3 — *“To you and to your seed will I give this land.”* The land grant at Abram's entry that Jasher 13:7 records.

old: Jubilees 16:9 — *And in this month Abraham moved from Hebron, and departed and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur in the mountains of Gerar.* The Jubilees apparatus records the same move to Gerar that opens Jasher 20:1.
new: Jubilees 16:10 — *Abraham moved from Hebron, and departed and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur in the mountains of Gerar.* The move to Gerar that opens Jasher 20:1.

old: Jubilees 17:17 — *And Yahuah (God) knew that Abraham was faithful in all his afflictions; for He had tried him through his country and with famine, and had tried him with the wealth of kings, and had tried him again through his wife, when she was torn (from him), and with circumcision, and had tried him through Ishmael and Hagar, his maid-servant, when he sent them away.* The live Jubilees apparatus tells the same prepared test of Abraham, naming the adversary Prince Mastema.
new: Jubilees 17:17 — *Yahuah (God) knew that Abraham was faithful in all his afflictions.* The trials already passed before the one Jasher 22:45 says Yahuah (the Lord) thought to try him with.

old: Jubilees 16:11 — *And in the middle of the fifth month he moved from thence, and dwelt at the Well of the Oath.* The same patriarchal event in the live Jubilees apparatus keeps Beersheba as the Well of the Oath.
new: Jubilees 16:11 — *he moved from thence, and dwelt at the Well of the Oath.* Beersheba, named for the oath Jasher 22:9 records.

old: Jubilees 18:1 — *And Elohim (God) said to him, “Abraham, Abraham”; and he said, “Behold, (here) am I.” . And He said, “Take your beloved son whom you love, (even) Isaac, and go to the high country, and offer him on one of the mountains which I will point out to you.”* Jubilees retells the identical command Jasher records, the same patriarchal event in the live self-linked apparatus.
new: Jubilees 18:2 — *Take your beloved son whom you love, (even) Isaac, and go to the high country.* The command that followed the "Here I am" of Jasher 23:1.

old: Jubilees 19:2 — *And in the first year of the third week of this jubilee the days of the life of Sarah were accomplished, and she died in Hebron.* The same death of Sarah whose bier (Jasher 24:14) gathers Shem and Eber — the Jubilees apparatus dates it to the third week of the jubilee in Hebron.
new: Jubilees 19:2 — *the days of the life of Sarah were accomplished, and she died in Hebron.* The death Jasher 24:14 says Shem and Eber followed to the bier.

old: Jubilees 19:8 — *This is the tenth trial wherewith Abraham was tried, and he was found faithful, patient in spirit.* The Jubilees apparatus narrates the same death of Sarah (Jasher 24:1) and reads Abraham's burying of his dead as a tenth trial faithfully endured.
new: Jubilees 19:8 — *This is the tenth trial wherewith Abraham was tried, and he was found faithful, patient in spirit.* Burying Sarah (Jasher 24:1) counted as Abraham's tenth trial.

old: Jubilees 22:1 — *And it came to pass in the first week in the forty-fourth jubilee, in the second year, that is, the year in which Abraham died, that Isaac and Ishmael came from the Well of the Oath to celebrate the feast of weeks... to Abraham, their father, and Abraham rejoiced because his two sons had come.* The Jubilees apparatus sets the same death of Abraham, with Isaac and Ishmael gathered, that Jasher 26:31 surrounds with the burial.
new: Jubilees 22:1 — *Isaac and Ishmael came from the Well of the Oath to celebrate the feast of weeks.* The last feast of the year that Jasher 26:31 closes with Abraham's burial.

old: Jubilees 19:13 — *And in the sixth week, in the second year thereof, Rebecca bare to Isaac two sons, Jacob and Esau, and Jacob was a smooth and upright man, and Esau was fierce, a man of the field, and hairy, and Jacob dwelt in tents.* The Jubilees apparatus narrates the same birth and the same dividing of the brothers as Jasher 26:14-15.
new: Jubilees 19:13 — *Rebecca bare to Isaac two sons, Jacob and Esau, and Jacob was a smooth and upright man.* The twins whose birth Jasher 26:15 records, already divided.

old: Jubilees 29:11 — *And on that day Esau, his brother, came to him, and he was reconciled to him, and departed from him to the land of Seir, but Jacob dwelt in tents.* Jasher 32:73's parting — Esau back to Seir, Jacob on to Canaan — is the same reconciliation and departure the Jubilees apparatus records.
new: Jubilees 29:13 — *he was reconciled to him, and departed from him to the land of Seir, but Jacob dwelt in tents.* The parting Jasher 32:73 shows from the road, Esau back to Seir.

old: Jubilees 32:1 — *And he abode that night at Bethel, and Levi dreamed that they had ordained and made him the priest of the El Elyon (Most High) Elohim (God), him and his sons for ever; and he awoke from his sleep and blessed Yahuah (God).* The live Jubilees apparatus narrates the same Bethel night that Jasher 36:1 opens.
new: Jubilees 32:1 — *Levi dreamed that they had ordained and made him the priest of the El Elyon (Most High) Elohim (God).* The Bethel night that Jasher 36:1 sent Jacob to.

old: Jubilees 32:30 — *And in the night, on the twenty-third of this month, Deborah Rebecca's nurse died, and they buried her beneath the city under the oak of the river, and he called the name of this place, 'The river of Deborah,' and the oak, 'The oak of the mourning of Deborah.' And Rebecca went and returned to her house to his father Isaac...* The live Jubilees apparatus narrates the same death and mourning-oak as Jasher 36:4-6.
new: Jubilees 32:30 — *Deborah Rebecca’s nurse died, and they buried her beneath the city under the oak of the river.* The mourning oak Jasher 36:6 names Allon-bachuth.

old: Jubilees 32:17 — *Your name shall not be called Jacob, but Yashar'el (Israel) shall they name your name.* The live Jubilees apparatus gives the same renaming Jasher 36:8 records.
new: Jubilees 32:17 — *“Your name shall not be called Jacob, but Yashar’el (Israel) shall they name your name.”* The renaming at Bethel that Jasher 36:8 records.

old: Jubilees 33:2 — *And Reuben saw Bilhah, Rachel's maid, the concubine of his father, bathing in water in a secret place, and he loved her.* The live Jubilees apparatus narrates the same Reuben-and-Bilhah sin Jasher 36:14 records.
new: Jubilees 33:2 — *Reuben saw Bilhah, Rachel’s maid, the concubine of his father, bathing in water in a secret place.* The sin Jasher 36:14 tells from the side of Reuben's anger.

old: Jubilees 33:22 — *And these were the names of the sons of Jacob: the first-born Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Yahudah (Judah), Issachar, Zebulon, the sons of Leah; and the sons of Rachel, Joseph and Benjamin; and the sons of Bilhah, Dan and Naphtali, and the sons of Zilpah, Gad and Asher; and Dinah, the daughter of Leah, the only daughter of Jacob.* The live Jubilees apparatus gives the same twelve-and-Dinah roster as Jasher 36:16-18.
new: Jubilees 33:22 — *these were the names of the sons of Jacob: the first-born Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Yahudah (Judah).* The twelve that Jasher 36:16 counts, here named by mother.

old: Jubilees 34:11 — *And they dealt treacherously with him, and formed a plot against him to slay him, but changing their minds, they sold him to Ishmaelite merchants, and they brought him down into Egypt, and they sold him to Potiphar, the eunuch of Pharaoh, the chief of the cooks, priest of the city of 'Êlêw. And the sons of Jacob slaughtered a kid, and dipped the coat of Joseph in the blood, and sent (it) to Jacob their father on the tenth of the seventh month.* The live Jubilees apparatus narrates the same kid-and-coat deceit as Jasher 43:13.
new: Jubilees 34:11 — *they dealt treacherously with him, and formed a plot against him to slay him.* The sale that the bloodied coat of Jasher 43:13 was sent to hide.

old: Jubilees 39:11 — *And the Egyptian saw the garment of Joseph and the broken door, and heard the words of his wife, and cast Joseph into prison into the place where the prisoners were kept whom the king imprisoned. And he was there in the prison; and Yahuah (God) gave Joseph favour in the sight of the chief of the prison guards and compassion before him, for he saw that Yahuah (God) was with him, and that Yahuah (God) made all that he did to prosper.* The live Jubilees apparatus carries the same imprisonment-yet-favor of Jasher 44:76.
new: Jubilees 39:11 — *cast Joseph into prison into the place where the prisoners were kept whom the king imprisoned.* The king's own prison, where Jasher 44:76 keeps him twelve years and where the road to Pharaoh began.

old: Jubilees 39:6 — *But he did not surrender his soul, and he remembered Yahuah (God) and the words which Jacob, his father, used to read from amongst the words of Abraham, that no man should commit fornication with a woman who has a husband; that for him the punishment of death has been ordained in the heavens before the El Elyon (Most High) Elohim (God), and the sin will be recorded against him in the eternal books continually before Yahuah (God). And Joseph remembered these words and refused to lie with her.* The live Jubilees apparatus grounds Joseph's refusal in Jasher 44:78 on Torah his fathers kept before Sinai.
new: Jubilees 39:6 — *he remembered Yahuah (God) and the words which Jacob, his father, used to read from amongst the words of Abraham.* The commandment Joseph kept in Jasher 44:78 was read aloud in his father's house before Sinai wrote it on stone.

old: Jubilees 39:3 — *And he set Joseph over all his house, and the blessing of Yahuah (God) came upon the house of the Egyptian on account of Joseph, and Yahuah (God) prospered him in all that he did.* The live Jubilees apparatus narrates the same elevation in Potiphar's house that Jasher 44:11 records.
new: Jubilees 39:3 — *the blessing of Yahuah (God) came upon the house of the Egyptian on account of Joseph.* The overseer of Jasher 44:11 brought the blessing of Abraham's house into a stranger's house.

old: Jubilees 41:19 — *And Yahudah (Judah) acknowledged, and said: “Tamar is more righteous than I am. And therefore let them burn her not.”* The Jubilees apparatus carries Judah's vindication of the very Tamar whose veiled meeting Jasher 45:31 narrates.
new: Jubilees 41:19 — *Tamar is more righteous than I am. And therefore let them burn her not.* Yahudah's (Judah's) confession at the end of the road Tamar sat down on in Jasher 45:31.

old: Jubilees 41:5 — *And Onan knew that the seed would not be his, (but) his brother's only, and he went into the house of his brother's wife, and spilt the seed on the ground, and he was wicked in the eyes of Yahuah (God), and He slew him.* The Jubilees apparatus tells the same slaying of Onan that Jasher 45:26 records.
new: Jubilees 41:5 — *Onan knew that the seed would not be his, (but) his brother’s only.* Why the work of Jasher 45:26 was evil: he would not raise a seed for his dead brother.

old: Jubilees 40:3 — *And he said before Pharaoh that his two dreams were one, and he said to him: “Seven years will come (in which there will be) plenty over all the land of Egypt, and after that seven years of famine, such a famine as has not been in all the land.”* The Jubilees apparatus gives the same one-dream reading of seven years' plenty and seven of famine that Jasher 48:54-55 unfolds.
new: Jubilees 40:3 — *he said before Pharaoh that his two dreams were one.* The same seven and seven that Jasher 48:55 unfolds, one reading for two dreams.

old: Jubilees 40:5 — *And Yahuah (God) gave Joseph favour and mercy in the eyes of Pharaoh, and Pharaoh said to his servants: “We shall not find such a wise and discreet man as this man, for the spirit of Yahuah (God) is with him.”* The Jubilees apparatus names the same Spirit upon Joseph that Jasher 48:52 reports clothing him before the king.
new: Jubilees 40:5 — *for the spirit of Yahuah (God) is with him.* Pharaoh's confession of the Spirit that Jasher 48:52 says clothed Joseph before the king.

old: Jubilees 40:2 — *And then the chief butler remembered Joseph and spake of him to the king, and he brought him forth from the prison, and he told his two dreams before him.* The Jubilees apparatus carries the same butler's remembrance and bringing-forth from prison that Jasher 48:30-41 unfolds.
new: Jubilees 40:2 — *the chief butler remembered Joseph and spake of him to the king.* The remembrance that Jasher 48:33 puts into the butler's own words before Pharaoh.

old: Jubilees 40:1 — *And in those days Pharaoh dreamed two dreams in one night concerning a famine which was to be in all the land, and he awoke from his sleep and called all the interpreters of dreams that were in Egypt, and magicians, and told them his two dreams, and they were not able to declare (them).* The Jubilees apparatus carries the same two-dream famine, the same baffled interpreters as Jasher 48:2,6.
new: Jubilees 40:1 — *Pharaoh dreamed two dreams in one night concerning a famine which was to be in all the land.* The dreams Jasher 48:2 begins at the river, and the magicians who could not read them.

old: Jubilees 40:8 — *And Joseph ruled over all the land of Egypt, and all the princes of Pharaoh, and all his servants, and all who did the king’s business loved him, for he walked in uprightness, for he was without pride and arrogance, and he had no respect of persons, and did not accept gifts, but he judged in uprightness all the people of the land.* The Jubilees apparatus carries the same provider-Joseph reigning over Egypt that Jasher 50:7 opens.
new: Jubilees 40:8 — *he had no respect of persons, and did not accept gifts, but he judged in uprightness.* The ruler under whom the seven years of plenty in Jasher 50:7 came to the land.

old: Jubilees 42:4 — *(Now the famine was very sore in the land of Canaan), and Jacob heard that there was food in Egypt, and he sent his ten sons that they should procure food for him in Egypt; but Benjamin he did not send.* The live Jubilees apparatus carries the identical descent of the ten in famine, Benjamin withheld.
new: Jubilees 42:4 — *he sent his ten sons that they should procure food for him in Egypt; but Benjamin he did not send.* The descent of the ten that Jasher 51:1 opens, with Benjamin kept at home.

old: Jubilees 43:14 — *And Joseph saw that they were all accordant in goodness one with another, and he could not refrain himself, and he told them that he was Joseph.* The Jubilees apparatus times the disclosure exactly as Jasher 54:69 does.
new: Jubilees 43:14 — *Joseph saw that they were all accordant in goodness one with another, and he could not refrain himself.* The moment Joseph could hold back no longer, and the words he said in Jasher 54:69.

old: Jubilees 43:13 — *Now rather let me, your servant, abide instead of the boy as a bondsman to my lord, and let the lad go with his brethren, for I became surety for him at the hand of your servant our father, and if I do not bring him back, your servant will bear the blame to our father for ever.* The Jubilees apparatus carries Yahudah's surety-plea word for word beside Jasher 54:57-58.
new: Jubilees 43:13 — *let me, your servant, abide instead of the boy as a bondsman to my lord.* The surety plea of Jasher 54:57, with Yahudah (Judah) offering himself in Benjamin's place.

old: Jubilees 38:16 — *And Bâlâq, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Danâbâ.* The Jubilees apparatus opens the Edom king-list with the same son of Beor and the same city that Jasher 57:42 crowns over Esau.
new: Jubilees 38:16 — *Bâlâq, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Danâbâ.* The first king of Edom, whose crowning Jasher 57:42 shows with the shout, May the king live.

old: Jubilees 38:10 — *And the sons of Jacob pressed hard upon the sons of Esau in the mountains of Seir, and bowed their necks so that they became servants of the sons of Jacob.* The Jubilees apparatus binds the same Seir conflict that Jasher 57:35 carries into the slaughter and resettling of the Horite land.
new: Jubilees 38:10 — *the sons of Jacob pressed hard upon the sons of Esau in the mountains of Seir, and bowed their necks.* Esau's sons bowed under Jacob's sons, and in Jasher 57:35 bowing the Horites under themselves.

old: Jubilees 38:8 — *And Simeon and Benjamin and Enoch, Reuben’s son, went forth on the west side of the tower, and fifty (men) with them, and they slew of Edom and of the Horites four hundred men, stout warriors; and six hundred fled, and four of the sons of Esau fled with them, and left their father lying slain, as he had fallen on the hill which is in ’Adûrâm.* The Jubilees apparatus records the very same battle and the slaying of the sons of Esau that Jasher 57:2 retells.
new: Jubilees 38:8 — *they slew of Edom and of the Horites four hundred men, stout warriors.* The war in which Esau fell; Jasher 57:2 is the later one where Joseph took Zepho in chains.

old: Jubilees 46:1 — *And it came to pass that after Jacob died the children of Yashar'el (Israel) multiplied in the land of Egypt, and they became a great nation, and they were of one accord in heart, so that brother loved brother and every man helped his brother, and they increased abundantly and multiplied exceedingly, ten weeks of years, all the days of the life of Joseph.* The Jubilees apparatus marks the same season Jasher 62 counts through — the fathers dying, the seed multiplying toward the bondage.
new: Jubilees 46:1 — *they became a great nation, and they were of one accord in heart, so that brother loved brother.* The multiplying that Jasher 62:1 counts by the deaths of the fathers, Reuben first.

old: Jubilees 46:8 — *And Joseph died in the forty-sixth jubilee, in the sixth week, in the second year, and they buried him in the land of Egypt, and his brethren died after him.* The Jubilees apparatus tells the same passing — Joseph buried, then his brethren dying after — that Jasher 62 spreads across its dated obituaries.
new: Jubilees 46:8 — *they buried him in the land of Egypt, and his brethren died after him.* The brethren dying after Joseph, counted one by one in Jasher 62; here Yahudah (Judah) at 129.

old: Jubilees 46:8 — *And Joseph died in the forty-sixth jubilee, in the sixth week, in the second year, and they buried him in the land of Egypt, and his brethren died after him.* The Jubilees apparatus narrates the same passing of Joseph and his brethren that Jasher 64:8 reports.
new: Jubilees 46:8 — *Joseph died in the forty-sixth jubilee, in the sixth week, in the second year.* The death that Zepho was waiting for in Jasher 64:8 before he came against the children.

old: Jubilees 46:15 — *And they made them serve with rigour, and the more they dealt evilly with them, the more they increased and multiplied.* The Jubilees apparatus carries the same wonder Jasher 67:59 stages — evil dealing only multiplies the chosen seed.
new: Jubilees 46:15 — *the more they dealt evilly with them, the more they increased and multiplied.* The rule Jasher 67:59 proves with ploughs that could not hurt the infants.

old: Jubilees 47:2 — *And Pharaoh, king of Egypt, issued a command regarding them that they should cast all their male children which were born into the river.* The Jubilees apparatus carries the same decree that Balaam counsels in Jasher 67:49 — the male children into the river.
new: Jubilees 47:2 — *they should cast all their male children which were born into the river.* The decree Balaam counselled in Jasher 67:49 to wipe away their name.

old: Jubilees 47:5 — *And in those days Tharmuth, the daughter of Pharaoh, came to bathe in the river, and she heard your voice crying, and she told her maidens to bring you forth, and they brought you to her.* The Jubilees apparatus names Pharaoh's daughter coming to bathe and lifting the crying child, parallel to Jasher 68:18-19.
new: Jubilees 47:5 — *Tharmuth, the daughter of Pharaoh, came to bathe in the river, and she heard your voice crying.* Pharaoh's daughter at the river, named Bathia in Jasher 68:18, lifting the child out of the decree.

old: Jubilees 47:2 — *And Pharaoh, king of Egypt, issued a command regarding them that they should cast all their male children which were born into the river.* The Jubilees apparatus carries the identical decree behind Jasher 68:11.
new: Jubilees 47:2 — *Pharaoh, king of Egypt, issued a command regarding them.* The decree that Jasher 68:11 shows carried out by Pharaoh's officers all the days.

old: Jubilees 47:9 — *And afterwards, when you were grown up, they brought you to the daughter of Pharaoh, and you did become her son, and Amram your father taught you writing, and after you had completed three weeks they brought you into the royal court.* The Jubilees apparatus narrates the same grown-in-the-court scene, the Angel of the Presence telling Moses his own preservation.
new: Jubilees 47:9 — *Amram your father taught you writing, and after you had completed three weeks they brought you into the royal court.* The son of Pharaoh's daughter in Jasher 70:33, who was taught by Amram before the court had him.

old: Jubilees 47:10 — *And you were three weeks of years at court until the time when you did go forth from the royal court and did see an Egyptian smiting your friend who was of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and you did slay him and hide him in the sand.* The Jubilees apparatus retells the same slaying that drives Moses' flight in Jasher 72:21.
new: Jubilees 47:10 — *did see an Egyptian smiting your friend who was of the children of Yashar’el (Israel), and you did slay him.* The slaying that sent Moses out of Egypt in Jasher 72:21.

old: Jubilees 14:13 — *And it came to pass, when the sun had set, that an ecstasy fell upon Abram, and lo! an horror of great darkness fell upon him, and it was said to Abram: “Know of a surety that your seed shall be a stranger in a land (that is) not theirs, and they will bring them into bondage, and afflict them four hundred years.* The live Jubilees apparatus carries the same covenant-darkness oracle to Abram that fixes the period Jasher 75:2 says Ephraim wrongly counted complete.
new: Jubilees 14:13 — *your seed shall be a stranger in a land (that is) not theirs, and they will bring them into bondage.* The appointed years that the sons of Ephraim in Jasher 75:2 counted finished before they were.

old: Jubilees 48:1 — *And in the sixth year of the third week of the forty-ninth jubilee you did depart and dwell in the land of Midian five weeks and one year. And you did return into Egypt in the second week in the second year in the fiftieth jubilee.* The live Jubilees apparatus dates the same Midian sojourn Jasher 76:13 begins.
new: Jubilees 48:1 — *you did depart and dwell in the land of Midian five weeks and one year.* The length of the sojourn that Jasher 76:13 begins at a well.

old: Jubilees 48:7 — *And everything took place according to your words; ten great and terrible judgments came on the land of Egypt that you might execute vengeance on it for Yashar'el (Israel). And Yahuah (God) did everything for Yashar'el's (Israel's) sake, and according to His covenant, which He had ordained with Abraham that He would take vengeance on them as they had brought them by force into bondage.* The live Jubilees apparatus reads Yahuah seeing the oppression (Jasher 78:15) as covenant-keeping vengeance for Israel's sake.
new: Jubilees 48:7 — *ten great and terrible judgments came on the land of Egypt that you might execute vengeance on it.* The answer to the cries Yahuah (the Lord) heard in Jasher 78:15.

old: Jubilees 48:1 — *And in the sixth year of the third week of the forty-ninth jubilee you did depart and dwell in the land of Midian five weeks and one year. And you did return into Egypt in the second week in the second year in the fiftieth jubilee.* The live Jubilees apparatus dates the very Midian sojourn Jasher 78:7 opens.
new: Jubilees 48:1 — *you did return into Egypt in the second week in the second year in the fiftieth jubilee.* The dated sojourn in which Jasher 78:7 places the marriage to Zipporah.

old: Jubilees 48:19 — *And we did not lead forth the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from Egypt empty handed.* The Jubilees apparatus narrates the same delivered seed that Jasher 81:4 brings out with a strong hand.
new: Jubilees 48:19 — *we did not lead forth the children of Yashar’el (Israel) from Egypt empty handed.* The going out that Jasher 81:4 sums up with a strong hand after two hundred and ten years.

old: Jubilees 46:9 — *the children of Yashar'el (Israel) brought forth all the bones of the children of Jacob save the bones of Joseph, and they buried them in the field in the double cave in the mountain.* The same burying of the bones of the twelve sons of Jacob that Jasher 90:38 narrates — the live Jubilees apparatus self-link.
new: Jubilees 46:9 — *brought forth all the bones of the children of Jacob save the bones of Joseph.* The bones of the brethren going home; Jasher 90:38 buries them later, each in his own inheritance.

old: Jubilees 13:20 — *For all the land which you see I shall give to you and to your seed for ever, and I shall make your seed as the sand of the sea: though a man may number the dust of the earth, yet your seed shall not be numbered.* The live Jubilees apparatus carries the same land-grant to Abraham's seed that Jasher 91:15 records as given to all Israel.
new: Jubilees 13:20 — *all the land which you see I shall give to you and to your seed for ever.* The oath to Abram that Jasher 91:15 shows kept to his seed.

old: Jubilees 3:26 — *And He made for them coats of skin, and clothed them, and sent them forth from the Garden of Eden.* Jubilees preserves the same expulsion behind the locked eastern gate of 1-adam-eve 54:3.
new: Jubilees 3:26 — *He made for them coats of skin, and clothed them, and sent them forth from the Garden of Eden.* The expulsion that 1 Adam and Eve 54:3 guards with a cherub at the gate.

old: *high places and groves and graven images... sacrifice their children to demons* (Jubilees 1:10) — the restored witness names the whole going-astray apparatus.
new: Jubilees 1:11 — *they will make to themselves high places and groves and graven images.* The pattern foretold to Moses, which Jeroboam built and staffed in 2 Chronicles 11:15.

old: Jubilees 46 walks the long sojourn-in-Egypt the patriarchal-Yoseph initiated. The Matthean Yoseph carrying the Messianic-child to Egypt at Matt 2:14 telescopes the same pattern.
new: Jubilees 46:1 — *the children of Yashar’el (Israel) multiplied in the land of Egypt, and they became a great nation.* Egypt sheltered the nation under one Joseph and the child under another (Matthew 2:14).

old: The seed of Ya'aqov (Jacob) chosen as Yahuah's firstborn at creation — the eternal designation behind the Hosea 11:1 / Exodus 4:22 / Matt 2:15 historical call.
new: Jubilees 2:20 — *have written him down as My firstborn son, and have sanctified him to Myself for ever and ever.* The son called out of Egypt (Matthew 2:15) is the firstborn son written down at creation.

old: *She was buried in the land of Ephrath, the same is Beth-lehem* — the geographic anchor of the matriarchal weeping Matt 2:18 cites.
new: Jubilees 32:34 — *she was buried in the land of Ephrath, the same is Bethlehem.* Rachel weeps at Matthew 2:18 from a grave on the Bethlehem road.

old: Jubilees 10:8 — *the chief of the spirits, Mastema, came and said: Yahuah (Lord), Creator, let some of them remain before me.* The Hebrew library names the chief-of-evil-spirits with an authorized role to lead astray and judge; the architecture Matt 4:1's *tempted of the devil* sits inside.
new: Jubilees 10:8 — *let some of them remain before me, and let them hearken to my voice.* The devil who tempted Yahusha (Jesus) in the wilderness (Matthew 4:1) works inside a permission he asked for.

old: Jubilees 11:5 — *Prince Mastema sent ravens and birds that they should eat the seed which was sown in the land.* Mastema's standing disruption-of-the-bread-supply pattern; Matt 4:3's stones-to-bread temptation walks the same architecture at the Messianic level.
new: Jubilees 11:11 — *the prince Mastêmâ sent ravens and birds to devour the seed which was sown in the land.* The enemy who stole the bread from the fields is the tempter who held out bread in the wilderness (Matthew 4:3).

old: Jubilees 17:16 — *the prince Mastema came and said before Elohim (God): Behold, Avraham (Abraham) loves Yitschaq (Isaac) his son... bid him offer him as a burnt-offering on the altar.* Mastema's role at the Aqedah; Matt 4:5-7's temple-pinnacle test walks the same testing-of-the-righteous-Son architecture.
new: Jubilees 17:16 — *bid him offer him as a burnt-offering on the altar, and You will see if he will do this command.* The accuser who proposed Abraham's trial proposes the Son's on the pinnacle (Matthew 4:5).

old: Jubilees 5:11 — *And He made for all His works a new and righteous nature, so that they should not sin in their whole nature for ever, but should be all righteous each in his kind alway.* The plant of righteousness and truth appearing in Enoch 11:6 is Jubilees' new and righteous nature made for all His works after the flood-judgement.
new: Jubilees 5:12 — *He made for all His works a new and righteous nature.* The plant of righteousness and truth of 1 Enoch 10:16 is this new nature made after the flood.

old: Jubilees 4:25 — *For Yahuah (God) has four places on the earth, the Garden of Eden, and the Mount of the East, and this mountain on which you are this day, Mount Sinai, and Mount Zion (which) will be sanctified in the new creation for a sanctification of the earth; through it will the earth be sanctified from all (its) guilt and its uncleanness throughout the generations of the world.* Jubilees counts Enoch's throne-mountain (25:3) among Yahuah's holy places on earth, sanctified in the new creation.
new: Jubilees 4:26 — *Mount Zion (which) will be sanctified in the new creation for a sanctification of the earth.* The mountain of 1 Enoch 25:3, whose summit is His throne, stands among the four holy places of the earth.

old: *called on the name of Yahuah... "You, the most high Elohim, are my Elohim for ever and ever"* (Jubilees 13:15) — the restored witness fills the covenant confession behind *Abram called on the name of Yahuah* (13:4).
new: Jubilees 13:15 — *he journeyed to the place where he had pitched his tent at the beginning, to the place of the altar.* The return of Genesis 13:4, with the words of the calling on the name given in the next verse.

old: *And he believed in Yahuah (God), and it was counted to him for righteousness* (Jubilees 14:6) — the restored witness sets the reckoning of 15:6 inside the covenant itself, beside *I shall be Elohim to you and to your seed after you*.
new: Jubilees 14:6 — *he believed in Yahuah (God), and it was counted to him for righteousness.* Genesis 15:6 word for word, spoken inside the covenant that names the land and the seed in the next breath.

old: Jubilees 5:23 — *And Yahuah (God) opened seven flood-gates of heaven, And the mouths of the fountains of the great deep, seven mouths in number. And the flood-gates began to pour down water from the heaven forty days and forty nights... Fifteen cubits did the waters rise above all the high mountains, And the ark was lift up above the earth.* Jubilees' seven flood-gates match Enoch's seven water torrents on the high roof (89:2).
new: Jubilees 5:24 — *the mouths of the fountains of the great deep, seven mouths in number.* The fountains Enoch saw opened on the surface of the enclosure (1 Enoch 89:3).

old: 1 Enoch 7:4 — *the giants turned against them and devoured mankind.* The devouring of Jubilees 5:2, with its cause.
new: Jubilees 5:2 — *they began to devour each other.* The devouring has a face: the giants *Who consumed all the acquisitions of men* (1 Enoch 7:3).

old: Jubilees 27:26 — *And Jacob vowed a vow to Yahuah (God), saying: 'If Yahuah (God) will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go... so that I come again to my father's house in peace, then shall Yahuah (God) be my Elohim (God)...'* The Bethel vow recorded earlier in Jubilees is exactly the return Jubilees 29:3 now sees fulfilled.
new: Jubilees 27:27 — *so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, then shall Yahuah (God) be my Elohim (God).* The dream at Jubilees 29:3 that sends him back to his father's house answers this vow.

old: Jubilees 40:10 — *And the king called Joseph’s name Sĕphânṭîphâns, 2 and gave Joseph to wife the daughter of Potiphar, the daughter of the priest of Heliopolis, the chief cook. 3 11. And on the day that Joseph stood before Pharaoh he was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh.* Jubilees gives the same new name, the priest's-daughter wife, and the thirty years that Jasher 49:21,36,38 record.
new: Jubilees 40:10 — *the king called Joseph’s name Sĕphânṭîphâns.* The new name Jasher 49:21 gives as Zaphnath Paaneah.

old: Jubilees 46:14 — *And he set over them taskmasters to afflict them with slavery; and they built strong 2 cities for Pharaoh, Pithom and Raamses, and they built all the walls and all the fortifications which had fallen in the cities of Egypt.* Jubilees names the same Pithom and Raamses and the same taskmasters of Jasher 65:8,26.
new: Jubilees 46:14 — *they built strong cities for Pharaoh, Pithom and Raamses.* The same two cities the Egyptians resolved to fortify at Jasher 65:8.

old: Jubilees 3:21 — *And He took fig-leaves and sewed (them) together, and made an apron for himself, and covered his shame. 32. And Elohim (God) cursed the serpent, and was wroth with it for ever….* Jubilees carries the same primeval history: the serpent Yahuah cursed in the garden is the same Satan now rallying his hosts to murder the man outside it.
new: Jubilees 3:22 — *he took fig-leaves and sewed (them) together, and made an apron for himself, and covered his shame.* The serpent cursed in the next line is the Satan who calls his hosts against the man at 1 Adam and Eve 48:1.

old: *he built there an altar to Yahuah (God)... at the Well of the Oath, and he was the first to celebrate the feast of tabernacles on the earth* (Jubilees 16:20-21) — the altar at the oath-well of 21:33 bound to the appointed times.
new: Jubilees 16:20 — *he celebrated a festival of joy in this month seven days.* The calling on the name at Beer-sheba (Genesis 21:33) was the first feast of tabernacles on the earth.

old: *I shall give to your seed all the earth which is under heaven... and inherit it for ever* (Jubilees 32:19) — the land-grant of *to thee I will give it, and to thy seed* (35:12) widened to the whole earth.
new: Jubilees 32:19 — *they will get possession of the whole earth and inherit it for ever.* The land of Genesis 35:12 widened to the whole earth for Jacob's seed.

old: Jubilees 5:23 — *Yahuah (God) opened seven flood-gates of heaven, And the mouths of the fountains of the great deep... until the whole world was full of water* the library's same Flood SELF-LINK; the world Peter says *perished* (2 Peter 3:6).
new: Jubilees 5:24 — *opened seven flood-gates of heaven, And the mouths of the fountains of the great deep.* The world Peter says *being overflowed with water, perished* (2 Peter 3:6).

old: Jubilees 1:25 — *they will all be called children of the living Elohim (God) ... and I am their Father.* *Ye must be born again* (John 3:7) is the doorway into the children-of-the-living the Hebrew library names as the destination of the heart-circumcision — the sonship promised the gathered who were once *not my people.*
new: Jubilees 1:25 — *they will all be called children of the living Elohim (God)... that these are My children, and that I am their Father.* *Ye must be born again* (John 3:7) is the doorway into the children-of-the-living the Hebrew library names as the destination of the heart-circumcision — the sonship promised the gathered who were once *not my people.*

old: Jubilees 16:12 — *at the time of which Yahuah (God) had spoken... on the festival of the first-fruits of the harvest, Isaac was born* the promise-child born on an appointed feast of the Most High (Galatians 4:23).
new: Jubilees 16:13 — *at the time of which Yahuah (God) had spoken... on the festival of the first-fruits of the harvest, Isaac was born* the promise-child born on an appointed feast of the Most High (Galatians 4:23).

old: Jubilees 27:26 — *And Jacob arose early in the morning, and took the stone which he had put under his head and set it up as a pillar for a sign… And Jacob vowed a vow to Yahuah (God)… of all that you give me, I shall give the tenth to you, my Elohim (God).* The pillar and the sacrifice of Jubilees 31:3 pay the vow Jubilees first recorded at the ladder.
new: Jubilees 27:26 — *And Jacob arose early in the morning, and took the stone which he had put under his head and set it up as a pillar for a sign, and he poured oil upon the top of it.* The pillar and the sacrifice of Jubilees 31:3 pay the vow Jubilees first recorded at the ladder.

old: Jubilees 39:11 — *And the Egyptian saw the garment of Joseph and the broken door, and heard the words of his wife, and cast Joseph into prison… and Yahuah (God) gave Joseph favour in the sight of the chief of the prison guards and compassion before him, for he saw that Yahuah (God) was with him, and that Yahuah (God) made all that he did to prosper.* The upright Joseph of Jubilees 40:8 is the same man who kept his purity in Jubilees 39:11 — “Yahuah was with him” ties the pit to the throne.
new: Jubilees 39:12 — *Yahuah (God) gave Joseph favour in the sight of the chief of the prison guards and compassion before him, for he saw that Yahuah (God) was with him, and that Yahuah (God) made all that he did to prosper.* The upright Joseph of Jubilees 40:8 is the same man who kept his purity in Jubilees 39:12 — “Yahuah was with him” ties the pit to the throne.

old: Jubilees 4:15 — *Mahalalel took to him to wife Dînâh, the daughter of Barâkî'êl the daughter of his father's brother, and she bare him a son... and he called his name Jared; for in his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers, that they should instruct the children of men.* Jubilees carries the same Mahalaleel-Jared generation of Jasher 2:37 and marks Jared's days as when the Watchers came down — the corruption Jasher's next chapters and 1 Enoch unfold.
new: Jubilees 4:15 — *Mahalalel took to him to wife Dînâh, the daughter of Barâkî’êl the daughter of his father’s brother, and she bare him a son... and he called his name Jared; for in his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers, that they should instruct the children of men.* Jubilees carries the same Mahalaleel-Jared generation of Jasher 2:37 and marks Jared's days as when the Watchers came down — the corruption Jasher's next chapters and 1 Enoch unfold.

old: Jubilees 4:17 — *And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom... And he was the first to write a testimony, and he testified to the sons of men among the generations of the earth* the wisdom Jasher 3:8 says the spirit of Elohim gave Enoch to teach all his men.
new: Jubilees 4:17 — *And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book.* the wisdom Jasher 3:8 says the spirit of Elohim gave Enoch to teach all his men.

old: Jubilees 5:19 — *...no man's person was accepted save that of Noah alone; for his person was accepted in behalf of his sons... for his heart was righteous in all his ways...* the same righteous Noah Jasher 4:15 says walked perfect and upright with Elohim while all flesh corrupted.
new: Jubilees 5:19 — *...no man’s person was accepted save that of Noah alone; for his person was accepted in behalf of his sons... for his heart was righteous in all his ways...* the same righteous Noah Jasher 4:15 says walked perfect and upright with Elohim while all flesh corrupted.

old: Jubilees 12:2 — *Worship the Elohim (God) of heaven, Who causes the rain and the dew to descend on the earth, And does everything upon the earth... Why do you worship things that have no spirit in them?* Jubilees gives the same father — an idolater Abram must rebuke — that Jasher shows bargaining with Nimrod.
new: Jubilees 12:4 — *Worship the Elohim (God) of heaven, Who causes the rain and the dew to descend on the earth, And does everything upon the earth, And has created everything by His word.* Jubilees gives the same father — an idolater Abram must rebuke — that Jasher shows bargaining with Nimrod.

old: Jubilees 48:12 — *the prince of the Mastêmâ ... cried to the Egyptians to pursue after you with all the powers of the Egyptians, with their chariots, and with their horses ... And I stood between the Egyptians and Yashar'el (Israel), and we delivered Yashar'el (Israel) out of his hand ... and Yahuah (God) brought them through the midst of the sea as if it were dry land.* Jubilees tells the same pursuit that overtakes Israel at the sea in Jasher 81:24.
new: Jubilees 48:12 — *the prince of the Mastêmâ... cried to the Egyptians to pursue after you with all the powers of the Egyptians, with their chariots, and with their horses, and with all the hosts of the peoples of Egypt.* Jubilees tells the same pursuit that overtakes Israel at the sea in Jasher 81:24.

old: Jubilees 10:8 — *And the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: “Yahuah (God), Creator, let some of them remain before me... for great is the wickedness of the sons of men.” And He said: “Let the tenth part of them remain before him, and let nine parts descend into the place of condemnation.”* As mercy curbs Mastema to a permitted tenth here, so mercy in 1 Adam & Eve 62:3 lets the buried figs live rather than perish.
new: Jubilees 10:9 — *Let the tenth part of them remain before him, and let nine parts descend into the place of condemnation.* As mercy curbs Mastema to a permitted tenth here, so mercy in 1 Adam & Eve 62:3 lets the buried figs live rather than perish.

old: Jubilees 4:17 — *And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book... And he was the first to write a testimony.* Enoch who "wrote a celebrated book" (22:2) is Jubilees' first man to write a testimony.
new: Jubilees 4:17 — *And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book.* Enoch who "wrote a celebrated book" (22:2) is Jubilees' first man to write a testimony.

old: Jubilees 12:17 — *All the signs of the stars, and the signs of the moon and of the sun are all in the hand of Yahuah (God)... You alone are my Elohim (God)... And You have created all things, And all things that are are the work of Your hands.* The parallel restored record gives Abraham's own confession of the Creator that meets the "I am He" of Apocalypse of Abraham 8:3.
new: Jubilees 12:19 — *You alone are my Elohim (God), And You and Your dominion have I chosen. And You have created all things, And all things that are are the work of Your hands.* The parallel restored record gives Abraham's own confession of the Creator that meets the "I am He" of Apocalypse of Abraham 8:3.

old: Jubilees 4:17 — *And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven... And he was the first to write a testimony.* Enoch the first writer is the pattern of Eve's charge — the antediluvian life set down in a testimony that outlasts the generations.
new: Jubilees 4:17 — *And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book.* Enoch the first writer is the pattern of Eve's charge — the antediluvian life set down in a testimony that outlasts the generations.

old: Jubilees 5:1 — *the angels of Elohim (God) saw them... and took themselves wives* — the Genesis 6 fall recorded; the servants Yahuah put no trust in.
new: Jubilees 5:1 — *the angels of Elohim (God) saw them... and they took themselves wives* — the Genesis 6 fall recorded; the servants Yahuah put no trust in.
